clue.text: Sisterliness essentially bent an ear

indicators.note: bent means twisted out of shape, so the remaining letters are rearranged
essentially points to the core of the word, so its outer pairs of letters at each end are dropped

explanation.surface: A remark that sisterly affection at heart lends a sympathetic ear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essentially' strips SI and SS from the ends of SISTERLINESS, leaving STERLINE; 'bent' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who lends an ear is a person paying attention to what is said.

clue.text: Set place on time for greedy beast

parts.note: a locus is a fixed position or place, especially in mathematics

explanation.surface: A fixed spot in good time for a voracious animal to arrive.
explanation.definitionFit: Swarms of these insects devour crops wholesale, the archetype of a ravenous creature.

clue.text: Kill off urge for food

parts.note: to scotch a rumour or plan is to put an end to it
to egg someone on is to urge them

explanation.surface: Suppress a craving to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: A SCOTCH EGG is a British snack: a boiled egg wrapped in sausage meat and breadcrumbs, then fried.
explanation.definitionFit: A picnic snack of boiled egg in sausage meat and crumbs is an item of food.

clue.text: Bow down here?

parts.note: reads as an invitation to kneel, but Bow is a district of London, found in the eastern part of the city

explanation.surface: A question about where one should kneel in reverence.
explanation.walkthrough: The EAST END is the eastern, traditionally working-class part of London; Bow is one of its districts. 'down' hints at being located there.
explanation.definitionFit: Bow lies in the eastern quarter of London, so that quarter is where Bow is found.

clue.text: Summon fine woman to embrace

indicators.note: to embrace is to hold within the arms, so one piece encloses the other

parts.note: Eve, the first woman in Genesis, is a stock crossword woman
OK means fine or acceptable

explanation.surface: Calling on a fine lady to give someone a hug.
explanation.definitionFit: To call up a memory or spirit is to bring it forth, as a summons does.

clue.text: Regularly dreary without pub service? Sort of

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so these letters go round the other piece
regularly means taking letters at even intervals, here the first, third and fifth of the word

parts.note: an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: A gloomy evening with no pub to serve anyone, more or less.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside here: the first, third and fifth letters of dreary, DER, surround INN. A dinner service is a set of plates, hence the hedged definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A dinner service is a matching set of crockery, so the meal's name is a kind of service.

clue.text: I see Texan migrating? Not true

indicators.note: migrating means moving to a new place, so these letters move about into a new order

parts.note: the letter C is said the same as see, a common crossword convention

explanation.surface: Spotting a Texan heading south for the winter, perhaps falsely.
explanation.definitionFit: Something imprecise or approximate is not strictly accurate.

clue.text: Mad as a head

definitions.meaning: like a nut, which is slang for the head

explanation.definitionFit: Crazy people are called nuts, and nut is slang for head, so the adjective covers both senses.

clue.text: Librarians essentially bind second unusual collections

indicators.note: essentially takes the heart of the word, dropping three letters from each end

parts.note: to tie is to bind

explanation.surface: Library staff are at heart required to bind a second set of unusual collections.
explanation.walkthrough: 'essentially' keeps the core RARI of LIBRARIANS.
explanation.definitionFit: Rare items are uncommon finds, and a collector's prize pieces are such things.

clue.text: Close account after first of June, beset by a depression

indicators.note: beset by means surrounded, so the J and account go inside

parts.note: a dent is a small depression in a surface

indicators.note: after places the account piece following the J
first of means only the opening letter of the next word is used

explanation.surface: Close to the account books at the start of June, besieged by a slump.
explanation.definitionFit: Neighbouring things lie close by, next to each other.

clue.text: This dog's for me

parts.note: this refers to the puzzle being solved
a setter is a breed of gun dog; the 's is a link here

explanation.surface: A pet owner announcing that this hound belongs to them.
explanation.walkthrough: Setters refer to themselves as 'me' in clues, so the definition is the puzzle's compiler.
explanation.definitionFit: When a puzzle says 'me', it means the person who compiled it.

clue.text: Hide in sector of Mediterranean island?

parts.note: SE stands for the south-east sector, a compass quarter
Crete is the largest Greek island in the Mediterranean

explanation.surface: Lying low in a corner of a Mediterranean island.
explanation.definitionFit: Glands release fluids, but the verb also means to conceal something away.

clue.text: He'd reveal constituents of any salt

definitions.text: He'd reveal constituents of any salt

indicators.note: the constituent letters of the phrase are broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: A chemist who can say what any salt is made of.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition and also the wordplay: rearranging ANY SALT gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A chemical examiner breaks a compound down to identify its parts.

clue.text: Star hen laid cracked eggs to begin with

indicators.note: cracked means broken apart, so the letters are reassembled
to begin with takes just the opening letter of the word

explanation.surface: A hen laid cracked eggs at the start, a star performance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cracked' rearranges HEN LAID into HEADLIN; 'to begin with' adds E from eggs.
explanation.definitionFit: To top the bill is to be the main attraction, as the lead act does.

clue.text: Cross about article ultimately revealing American scandal

indicators.note: about means going round, so the other pieces sit inside

parts.note: cross means angry, irate
an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: ultimately takes the final letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Angry about a piece of writing that finally exposes a scandal in the US.
explanation.walkthrough: IRANGATE (Iran-Contra) was the 1980s US scandal over secret arms sales to Iran.
explanation.definitionFit: The Iran-Contra affair, covert arms deals under Reagan, was a major political scandal in the United States.

clue.text: Veto query involving female cover-up?

indicators.note: involving means containing, so the answer is found inside the words

explanation.surface: Blocking a question that involves a woman in a cover-up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cover-up' is the misleading part: a toque is a small brimless hat, traditionally a woman's.
explanation.definitionFit: A brimless hat worn by women covers the head.

clue.text: Questioning curious definition?

parts.note: the first two words are themselves a dictionary gloss, so the clue is a definition of a word meaning questioning and curious

explanation.surface: Querying an odd dictionary entry.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue describes itself: 'questioning, curious' is how a dictionary would define the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A puzzled, enquiring look or manner is both questioning and curious.

clue.text: Country river smell needs help to lift

parts.note: the Cam is the river through Cambridge
BO is body odour

indicators.note: in a down clue, to lift is to raise, so the word reads upwards

parts.note: aid means help

explanation.surface: A river's stench requires assistance to clear it.
explanation.definitionFit: A Southeast Asian kingdom bordering Thailand and Vietnam is a nation.

clue.text: Predict return of game after a month

indicators.note: after puts the reversed game following the month

parts.note: Aug is the abbreviation for August

indicators.note: return of means the letters come back the other way

parts.note: RU is rugby union

explanation.surface: Forecasting a rematch a month later.
explanation.definitionFit: To foretell is to give a sign of what is to come, as an omen does.

clue.text: Commanded fell, reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly signals a word that is heard rather than seen

parts.note: rain fell, so it rained

explanation.surface: Ordered someone to go down, so it is said.
explanation.definitionFit: A monarch who ruled held sovereign authority and gave orders.

clue.text: Body containing a drug

parts.note: a steroid is a drug, as used by cheating athletes

explanation.surface: A corpse found with an illicit substance inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Body' suggests a corpse, but it is a celestial body orbiting the Sun.
explanation.definitionFit: A rocky lump orbiting the Sun is a heavenly body.

clue.text: Possibly slatty slutty woman has time to move

indicators.note: to move means this letter is shifted to a different position in the word

parts.note: trollop is an old-fashioned insult for a promiscuous woman

explanation.surface: A loose woman has a moment to move on.
explanation.walkthrough: A roll-top desk has a sliding cover made of slats, hence 'possibly slatty'.
explanation.definitionFit: A desk lid of linked wooden strips is slatted, as the definition hints.

clue.text: Topless oriental shows behind

indicators.note: topless removes the top letter, the first in a down entry

parts.note: eastern means oriental

explanation.surface: A topless Eastern woman shows her bottom.
explanation.definitionFit: On a ship, towards the stern means at the back.

clue.text: Engaging cuisine about to be blessed

indicators.note: to be means the about letter is to become the blessed letter

parts.note: cooking is a style of food or cuisine
C is circa, about
B is an abbreviation for blessed

explanation.surface: Appealing food about to be blessed before a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: Swap C (circa) in COOKING for B (blessed). 'Engaging' means hiring or reserving.
explanation.definitionFit: Reserving a table or hiring a performer is taking them on in advance.

clue.text: Charity, for example, unusually shunned by sick leper

indicators.note: unusually means not in the normal order, and the sick leper letters are struck from the mixed phrase

explanation.surface: A charity helping a sick leper, for instance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusually' and 'sick' both mark rearrangement and 'shunned by' takes LEPER out: FOR EXAMPLE minus LEPER leaves FOXAM to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A British aid organisation fighting poverty worldwide is a well-known charity.

clue.text: They're instrumental in 3-4

parts.note: suggests things helpful in a score of three-four, but it means pieces of music written in three-four time

explanation.surface: Things that played a key part in a 3-4 result.
explanation.walkthrough: 3-4 looks like a football score, but it is the time signature of three beats to the bar.
explanation.definitionFit: Ballroom dances in three-four time have music played on instruments.

clue.text: Make flutter about end of race

indicators.note: about means going round, so the wave piece surrounds the other

parts.note: a flag that flutters waves

indicators.note: end of takes the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: Get something fluttering towards the finish of a race.
explanation.definitionFit: To interlace threads into cloth is to make fabric.

clue.text: The foreign recital's sure to lead

indicators.note: to lead puts the sure piece in front

parts.note: definite means sure

indicators.note: foreign means strange or alien, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: A foreign concert is certain to take the lead.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is just 'The', the grammatical term for it.
explanation.definitionFit: In grammar, 'the' is the specifying determiner as opposed to 'a'.

clue.text: Girl embracing serviceman, one in fleet

indicators.note: embracing means holding, so the other pieces go inside

parts.note: Ada is a girl's name
RM is a Royal Marine
A means one

explanation.surface: A girl hugging a sailor, one of a fleet.
explanation.definitionFit: A large naval force of warships, like the Spanish one of 1588.

clue.text: Pumped-up charge dropper

parts.note: sounds like an overexcited person cutting a fee, but means an inflated airship that drops bombs

explanation.surface: An overexcited person cutting prices.
explanation.walkthrough: These German airships, inflated with gas, dropped bombs on Britain in the First World War.
explanation.definitionFit: The gas-filled German airship bombed cities from above.
